title: Associate Director - Technology & Internet
description:
**About us:**

1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support platform with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice offers an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation, Execution and Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping them solve a wide variety of business and organizational problems through actionable research-led insights.

**About the role:**

As an Associate Director (AD) you will have four key responsibilities (1) Ensuring project delivery (2) Client management (3) Team management and (4) Supporting business development.

* The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice.

* This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior leaders across the **Technology & Internet sector, including SaaS, Enterprise Software, Consumer Internet, AI / DeepTech, Logistics, TravelTech, AgriTech, E-commerce, and related technology and internet segments.** This will require playing a significant role in influencing client thinking, identifying opportunities for account expansion, supporting proposal development, and assisting the Director in driving opportunities to closure. This will also involve ensuring high-quality project delivery through your teams to maintain high client satisfaction and drive repeat business.

* This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members, including mid-management members who will be responsible for project delivery, and junior team members for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process, managing complex engagements, and generating actionable insights that help clients make strategic and operational business decisions.

* You will also play a very meaningful leadership role internally and assume the leadership responsibility for your team. You will support the 1Lattice culture by motivating your colleagues and helping team members under you train and develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall help them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth and overall engagement, while fostering a high-performance and collaborative team environment.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts.
* Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts.
* Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives.
* Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives.
* End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement.
* Driving thought leadership in projects and developing compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to complex client challenges.
* Managing team growth and satisfaction – being responsible for their success while building a strong team culture.
* Playing an active role in recruitment and building project delivery teams within the vertical.

**Competencies and skills****:**

* Deep understanding of the **Technology & Internet domain**, including SaaS, Enterprise Software, Consumer Internet, AI / DeepTech, Logistics, TravelTech, AgriTech, E-commerce, and related technology and internet industries. Experience within a technology or internet company is an added advantage.
* Proven experience in business research, consulting, market intelligence, or data services, with a minimum of **8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the Technology & Internet industry**.
* Strong and credible industry relationships, with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships across the technology and internet ecosystem.
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives to maximise conversions.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation towards planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency.
* Strong team management skills, including building a high-performance culture, driving impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and engagement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive insights from data, industry trends, market developments, and stakeholder discussions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written (reports, presentations, proposals) and verbal (client interactions and executive presentations).

**Educational qualification and Certifications:**

* Consistent track record of academic excellence - at least an MBA degree.
* Demonstration of leadership in educational and professional career. Experience in secondary and primary research of 5 yrs+ is a must.
* Very high drive and energy.
* Clear, confident and articulate presentation skills.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Sales Manager

**Location:** Malleswaram, Bangalore  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development

Job Summary

We are looking for a **results-driven and proactive Sales Manager** to lead institutional sales and business development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and acquiring schools and educational institutions, managing the sales pipeline, building strategic partnerships, negotiating deals, and achieving revenue and account acquisition targets.

This is a **field-oriented role** requiring strong communication, relationship-building, negotiation, networking, and sales management skills, along with a willingness to travel across assigned territories.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Institutional Outreach & Business Development

* Identify, approach, and convert prospective schools, educational institutions, and other institutional clients through field visits, calls, referrals, networking, and other outreach channels.
* Develop and execute territory-wise outreach plans aligned with monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified institutional prospects.
* Research and identify new markets, geographies, and institutional segments for business expansion.

2. Client Acquisition & Account Management

* Conduct effective product and program presentations for school owners, trustees, directors, principals, HODs, and other key decision-makers.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with internal teams to develop relevant proposals and program packages.
* Prepare, present, and follow up on business proposals to drive conversions.
* Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Conduct regular client meetings and follow-ups to identify opportunities for repeat business and expansion.

3. Sales Pipeline & Database Management

* Create and maintain a comprehensive database of schools, educational institutions, prospects, channel partners, and key decision-makers.
* Maintain a minimum database of **100+ qualified leads** within the assigned territory.
* Maintain an updated sales pipeline covering lead status, interactions, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations, and closure stages.
* Accurately update meeting trackers, call logs, sales reports, and other business development records using **Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and/or CRM tools**.

4. Negotiation & Deal Closure

* Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation and qualification to proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Lead negotiations with school management, principals, trustees, procurement committees, and other stakeholders.
* Develop commercial proposals and negotiate terms to maximise revenue, profitability, and long-term business value.
* Consistently achieve and, where possible, exceed account acquisition, revenue, and closure targets.

5. Agreements, Collections & Post-Sales Coordination

* Prepare, send, and track service agreements for finalized accounts in coordination with relevant internal teams.
* Follow up on documentation, agreement completion, invoicing, and timely payment collection.
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth onboarding and implementation of closed accounts.
* Maintain regular communication with clients during the post-sales and implementation stages.

6. Channel Partner & Strategic Partnerships

* Identify, research, onboard, and manage channel partners, institutions, businesses, and other strategic stakeholders.
* Develop mutually beneficial partnerships to generate leads and expand market reach.
* Build a strong professional network within the education and institutional ecosystem.
* Explore partnership opportunities that can contribute to business growth and client acquisition.

7. Market Research & Business Strategy

* Conduct regular research on market trends, competitor offerings, pricing, institutional requirements, and emerging opportunities.
* Analyse competitor activity and identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Research and qualify potential leads and develop targeted outreach strategies.
* Provide market insights and recommendations to the leadership team.

8. Sales & Marketing Planning

* Contribute to the development and execution of sales and marketing plans.
* Support the setting of sales goals and targets for different products and offerings.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand visibility, lead generation, market penetration, and revenue growth.
* Monitor the effectiveness of outreach and sales activities and recommend improvements.

9. Events, Conferences & Brand Representation

* Represent the organisation at education conferences, exhibitions, institutional events, networking meets, and other business forums.
* Support event planning, stall setup, presentations, promotional activities, and lead generation.
* Build professional networks through industry events and conferences.
* Ensure timely follow-up and conversion of leads generated through events.

10. Team Training & Support

* Support the training, mentoring, and coaching of Sales Associates and other team members when required.
* Share successful sales practices, market insights, and client feedback with the wider team.
* Assist team members in improving prospecting, presentations, negotiations, and follow-up practices.

11. Budget & Performance Management

* Support planning and management of budgets for field activities, client meetings, events, conferences, and outreach campaigns.
* Ensure effective utilisation of approved sales and marketing resources.
* Monitor field and sales-related expenditure within approved budgets.
* Prepare sales reports, dashboards, activity reports, and management updates.

12. Sales Performance & Reporting

* Track and analyse key sales performance indicators, including:
* Lead generation
* Qualified leads
* Meetings and presentations
* Pipeline value
* Proposals submitted
* Conversion rates
* Account closures
* Revenue
* Collections
* Provide regular sales updates, business insights, and recommendations to the Sales Lead/Leadership Team.
* Identify gaps in sales performance and implement corrective action plans.

13. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate closely with Academic, Content, Program, Operations, Finance, and other internal teams.
* Act as a bridge between clients and internal teams to ensure clear communication of client requirements and expectations.
* Ensure smooth transition from sales closure to onboarding and implementation.
* Support client retention by ensuring timely resolution of business and operational requirements.

14. Travel & Field Engagement

* Travel across assigned cities and towns for client meetings, presentations, institutional visits, follow-ups, conferences, networking events, and business development activities.
* Maintain a strong field presence and consistently engage with institutional decision-makers.
* Demonstrate flexibility and readiness to work in a field-oriented role involving regular travel.

Qualification & Experience

* Graduate degree in any discipline; **Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or related fields preferred**.
* Prior experience in **B2B sales, institutional sales, education sales, business development, or related fields** will be preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of client outreach, cold calling, emailing, lead generation, presentations, negotiations, and follow-ups.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets**; knowledge of CRM tools is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in **English**.
* Ability to create and maintain accurate sales databases and manage **100+ qualified leads**.
* Strong understanding of contemporary sales and marketing techniques as well as foundational sales practices.

Key Skills

* Institutional Sales
* B2B Sales
* Business Development
* Lead Generation
* Client Acquisition
* Account Management
* Relationship Management
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Negotiation & Closing
* Market Research
* Channel Partnerships
* Presentation Skills
* Cold Calling & Email Outreach
* CRM & Database Management
* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
* Sales Reporting & Analytics
* Team Management & Mentoring
* Communication & Networking

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly target-oriented and driven by results.
* Confident in interacting with senior decision-makers.
* Strong in communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management.
* Comfortable with field sales and regular travel.
* Proactive in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities.
* Well-organised and capable of managing multiple leads, meetings, proposals, and follow-ups simultaneously.
* Analytical and comfortable working with sales data and reports.
* Capable of researching markets, identifying prospects, and developing effective outreach strategies.
* A strong team player who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Able to manage time efficiently and consistently work towards monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Qualified leads generated
* Number of institutional meetings and presentations
* Sales pipeline value
* Proposal-to-conversion ratio
* New accounts acquired
* Revenue generated
* Collection performance
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly targets
* Channel/strategic partnerships developed
* Client retention and relationship quality
* Accuracy and consistency of sales reporting

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Associate
description:
Job Description

**Finance & MIS Associate / Assistant Manager**

**Location:** Bangalore, India (on-site)  
**Role Type:** Full-time

**About Us**

SUIND is an autonomy-first aerial robotics company building reliable, scalable near-earth drone systems that operate in complex, real-world environments — farms, plantations, infrastructure sites and industrial assets where GPS is unreliable and conditions are demanding. Our enterprise platform Bumblebee is DGCA type-certified and already in commercial deployment, and we are actively developing our next platform for inspection and aerial intelligence.

Backed by recent seed funding and recognised as a DPIIT startup, we are a small, multidisciplinary team spanning core autonomy, embedded systems, field operations and manufacturing. The work is hard, interdisciplinary and deeply hands-on — building technology from India for global-scale markets.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a Finance & MIS Associate / Assistant Manager to work closely with our Head of Finance as we build out our finance systems for the company's next stage of growth. This is not just a bookkeeping role — you will help design and implement the processes, tools and reporting that support accounting, compliance, MIS, banking and business reporting. You will have the autonomy to own day-to-day operations and the opportunity to work directly with leadership in a fast-growing deep-tech company.

**What You'll Do**

* Own and run day-to-day accounting and finance operations.
* Process vendor invoices, payment documentation and expense tracking.
* Support GST, TDS, payroll and statutory compliance preparation.
* Handle bank reconciliations, accounting entries and banking interactions.
* Prepare monthly MIS, budget-versus-actual tracking and cash-flow reports for investors and the board.
* Maintain trackers for receivables, payables, purchase orders and collections.
* Coordinate with operations and manufacturing teams on inventory and production-related finance records.
* Support audit schedules, due-diligence data and investor reporting.
* Help implement and adopt new finance automation tools, replicating or improving existing processes.
* Coordinate with vendors, consultants, auditors and internal teams on finance documentation.

**What You'll BringMust-Have**

* 2-4 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, audit, MIS or business finance (articleship plus early experience welcome).
* Practical problem-solving judgment — the ability to handle real, ambiguous scenarios, not just cite rules.
* Good understanding of accounting fundamentals, GST, TDS, invoices and reconciliations.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort with Tally.
* Proactive, clear communication and the confidence to flag issues early.
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience at a startup, manufacturing, hardware, drone, robotics or technology company.
* Comfort in Kannada and Hindi in addition to English.
* Exposure to inventory accounting or project-based cost tracking.
* Experience supporting audits, due diligence or investor MIS.
* Curiosity and initiative to learn the business beyond assigned tasks.

**Logistics**

* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Department:** Finance
* **Location:** Bangalore, India
* **Work Mode:** On-site (5 days a week, limited work-from-home flexibility for genuine need)
* **Reports To:** Head of Finance
* **Working Hours:** Core hours 10:00–18:00, approximately 42 hours a week

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
